roadmap.title: First playthrough
roadmap.description: Play the full story, buying costumes, training on the Digifarm and fighting for conversions and digivolutions as they open.

roadmap.title: Post-game cleanup
roadmap.description: After the final boss, load the cleared save to finish the end-of-story side missions, Outer Dungeons, Greatest OMNI Carnival, card quest and Agent Rank.

roadmap.title: New Game Plus on Mega+
roadmap.description: Start New Game Plus on an easier difficulty and switch to Mega+ before the final boss.

achievements.description: Defeat an enemy for the first time.
achievements.sortReason: Tutorial battle early in the story.
achievements.summary: Win your first fight against an enemy.

steps.text: Win the first battle in the opening tutorial.

achievements.description: Convert a Digimon with a Scan Rate of 200%.
achievements.sortReason: Raise Scan Rate on early wild Digimon.
achievements.summary: Convert a Digimon that has a 200% Scan Rate.

guide.context: Each defeat adds about 20% Scan Rate, and Convert works once the rate is between 100% and 200%.

steps.text: Defeat the same wild Digimon again and again until its Scan Rate reaches 200%.
Open the @mechanic{Digivice}, open the Digimon menu, select @mechanic{Convert}, and pick that Digimon.

achievements.description: Witness signs of an anomaly.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission Signs of an Anomaly.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Signs of an Anomaly} by defeating @enemy{Kuwagamon}.

achievements.description: Get caught in the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building explosion.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission The View after the End.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The View after the End}. The explosion scene unlocks the achievement.

achievements.description: Travel through time into the past.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission The Time Stranger.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Time Stranger} to travel into the past.

achievements.description: Visit the special dimension between space-time worlds known as the In-Between.
achievements.summary: Enter the In-Between Theater for the first time in the main mission The Time Stranger.

steps.text: While playing @loc{The Time Stranger}, use the door in the @loc{Kabukicho back alley} to step into the @loc{In-Between Theater}.

achievements.description: Befriend Minervamon.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission Shinjuku Rhapsody and befriend Minervamon.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Shinjuku Rhapsody} by defeating @enemy{Greymon (Blue)}.

achievements.description: Visit the Digital World.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission To the Untrodden World to visit the Digital World.

steps.text: Finish @loc{To the Untrodden World}.

achievements.description: Reclaim Central Tower.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission Gathering Storm Clouds by reclaiming Central Tower.

guide.context: @npc{Merukimon} joins the fight partway through, which makes it easier.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Parrotmon}, the boss waiting on top of @loc{Central Tower}.

achievements.description: Restore the reactor located in the Factorial Area.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission Incoming Conflict by restoring the reactor in Factorial Area.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Incoming Conflict} by defeating @enemy{UltimateBrachiomon} and @enemy{Vulcanusmon}.

achievements.description: Drive the Titans from the Abyss Area.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission On the Shores of Another World by driving the Titans from Abyss Area.

steps.text: Finish @loc{On the Shores of Another World} by defeating @enemy{Sharkmon}.

achievements.description: Digivolve into Aegiochusmon.
achievements.summary: Digivolve into Aegiochusmon, which happens at the end of the main mission The Defense of Nishi-Shinjuku.

steps.text: At the temple where @npc{Junomon} waits, defeat the three Ogremon-type enemies.
Watch the cutscenes and go through the portal. The achievement unlocks when you regain control in the real world.

achievements.description: Return to Shinjuku eight years in the future.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission Revelation in the White Light by arriving in Shinjuku eight years ahead.

steps.text: In past Shinjuku, follow @npc{Junomon}'s treasure and defeat @enemy{Titamon}. Fire and Holy moves deal strong damage.
Watch the cutscenes in the @loc{In-Between Theater}. The achievement unlocks when you can move again eight years ahead.

achievements.description: Deliver the wine to Neptunemon.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission Red Seas and Regret.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Red Seas and Regret} by defeating @enemy{SkullSeadramon}.

achievements.description: Rewrite the Abyss Area's destiny.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission A Promise on a Scarf.

steps.text: Finish @loc{A Promise on a Scarf} by defeating @enemy{Calmaramon}.

achievements.description: Rewrite the Gear Forest's destiny.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission The Titans' Grudge.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Titans' Grudge} by defeating @enemy{Witchmon} and @enemy{TyrantKabuterimon}.

achievements.description: Become the SDGP Champion.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission The Destruction of All Order and become the SDGP Champion.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Destruction of All Order}.

achievements.description: Become the PCGT Champion.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission The Paradise Colosseum and become the PCGT Champion.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Paradise Colosseum} by defeating @enemy{Callismon}.

achievements.description: Reclaim Central Town.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission The God of Speed's Wish to reclaim Central Town.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The God of Speed's Wish} by defeating @enemy{VenomMyotismon}.

achievements.description: Get the truth from Plutomon.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission Throne of the Underworld.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Throne of the Underworld} by defeating @enemy{ZombiePlutomon}.

achievements.description: Rescue Vulcanusmon.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission No Cure for Stupidity to rescue Vulcanusmon.

steps.text: Finish @loc{No Cure for Stupidity} by defeating @enemy{Power Loader}.

achievements.description: Free Junomon from the spell.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission The Mad Oracle to free Junomon from the spell.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Mad Oracle} by defeating @enemy{Junomon HM}.

achievements.description: Light the light clock's final light.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission The Cycle of Time to light the light clock's final light.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Cycle of Time}.

achievements.description: Renew the vow that Aegiomon pledged under the starry sky.
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission The Cycle of Time to renew Aegiomon's vow.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Cycle of Time}. This achievement unlocks in the same mission as @loc{The Final Light}.

achievements.displayName: To a World Far, Far Away
achievements.description: Bring an end to the story.
achievements.summary: Clear the closing story chapter, called Final Battle Over the Natural Order.

guide.context: The mission is a chain of boss fights against Barbamon, Creepymon, Lilithmon, Leviamon, Lucemon SM and Beelzemon BM, followed by Belphemon RM and Chronomon.

steps.text: Win each boss fight until @enemy{Chronomon} falls.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Mega + difficulty.
achievements.sortReason: New Game Plus, Mega+ final boss.
achievements.summary: Complete the game on Mega+ difficulty.

guide.context: Mega+ blocks escaping and item use in battle, so healing has to come from skills. A team that worked: @enemy{Apocalymon} using Darkness-Zone each turn, plus two healers with the Great Embrace personality skill (Overprotective personality, raises max HP to double), X-Aura and X-Revive. Wear Multi Wall for status immunity. During Chronomon's de-digivolve phase, X-Aura lets healers keep healing.

steps.text: Clear the story once to unlock New Game Plus, then start a New Game Plus.
Get every item you want before the final area. The smith cannot be used in @loc{Akashic Records}.
Switch the difficulty to @mechanic{Mega+} in Options before the last battle at @loc{Akashic Records: Innermost Depths}, then defeat @enemy{Chronomon} on Mega+.
Keep playing through the credits. The achievement unlocks afterward.

achievements.description: Achieve a rating of "EXCELLENT!!!" when attacking an enemy's weak point.
achievements.sortReason: Weak-point hits occur during the Parrotmon fight.
achievements.summary: Get an EXCELLENT!!! rating by attacking an enemy's weak point.

guide.context: You can also reach it by hitting an enemy's attribute and element weakness yourself.

steps.text: Fight the @enemy{Parrotmon} boss on @loc{Central Tower}. Once @npc{Merukimon} joins, his opening attack deals Excellent damage.

achievements.description: Defeat an enemy of Ultimate or greater Generation with a single DigiAttack.
achievements.sortReason: Needs a strong Digimon; later game is easier.
achievements.summary: Defeat an enemy of Ultimate generation or higher with a single DigiAttack.

guide.context: Only party Battle Members can DigiAttack. DigiAttack uses no SP and picks the member best suited to the enemy. Raise your Digimon above the enemy's level and carry varied elemental skills so the hit lands on a weakness.

steps.text: Face an Ultimate or higher enemy on the field and press the DigiAttack key (E on keyboard) once. A kill skips the battle.

achievements.description: Digivolve a Digimon for the first time.
achievements.sortReason: First Digivolution happens in the early story.
achievements.summary: Digivolve one of your Digimon for the first time.

steps.text: Digivolve any Digimon from the Digivice when the game offers it.

achievements.description: De-Digivolve a Digimon for the first time.
achievements.sortReason: First De-Digivolution in the early story.
achievements.summary: De-Digivolve one of your Digimon for the first time.

steps.text: De-Digivolve any Digimon from the Digivice.

achievements.description: Train Digimon on the Digifarm 30 times.
achievements.summary: Complete 30 Digifarm training sessions.

guide.context: Each training normally takes 30 real minutes. Quick Complete costs yen, so keep some on hand.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{Digifarm} through the In-Between Theater reception and choose @mechanic{Training}.
Pick a Training Set and a Digimon. Start the training, then pick @mechanic{Quick Complete Training} to finish it for yen.
Repeat until the achievement unlocks. Any Digimon counts.

achievements.description: Win a card battle.
achievements.summary: Win a card battle.

steps.text: Challenge a card-battle NPC in the world and win.

achievements.description: Obtain a legendary card.
achievements.summary: Obtain a legendary card.

guide.context: Needs the end-of-story side missions to be open. A lost card battle can be retried. Play high-number cards with good generation fit. If your hand is weak, hold two cards that share an attribute or generation; that can create a new card when the round ends.

steps.text: Open @npc{King Drasil}'s Royal Knights mission, then go to the top of @loc{Central Tower} with @npc{Agumon} and @npc{Gabumon}. This opens the side mission @loc{A Facilitator's Woes}; finish it.
Time Jump to the present-day @loc{Higashi-Shinjuku: Back Alley}, then ride a taxi to the @loc{Electric Town South Exit} of @loc{Akihabara Station}, and talk to @npc{Card King}.
Beat @npc{Card King} in a card battle, then beat the @npc{True Card King} in @loc{Shinjuku: East Shopping District}.

achievements.description: Digivolve into Aegiochusmon: Dark.
achievements.summary: Digivolve Aegiomon into Aegiochusmon: Dark.

guide.context: Most Anomaly Points come from completing every side mission, including the ones that open after the final boss. Skills cannot be refunded, so save before spending points to be able to reload.

steps.text: Reach Agent Rank 9 or higher.
Raise Aegiomon to at least 3070 ATK and 2980 INT.
Learn 46 Agent Skills each in Bonds of Valor, Amicability and Wisdom.
Digivolve Aegiomon into Aegiochusmon: Dark in the Digivice.

achievements.description: Add Chronomon: Destroy Mode to your Field Guide.
achievements.summary: Add Chronomon: Destroy Mode to your Field Guide.

guide.context: You need every side mission, including post-game ones, to earn enough Anomaly Points. Skills cannot be refunded, so save before spending points to be able to reload.

steps.text: Reach Agent Rank 10 and learn 46 Agent Skills each in Bonds of Valor, Philanthropy, Amicability and Wisdom.
Digivolve Aegiochusmon: Dark into Chronomon DM. The path runs Punimon to Tsunomon to Elecmon to Aegiomon to Aegiochusmon: Dark to Chronomon DM.

achievements.description: Collect ten or more costumes.
achievements.sortReason: Clothes shop opens after The Time Stranger.
achievements.summary: Own 10 or more costumes.

guide.context: DLC outfits also count.

steps.text: Go to the clothes shop in @loc{Shinjuku: East Shopping District} after finishing @loc{The Time Stranger}.
Buy every item. Each costs about 1,000 to 2,000 yen.

achievements.description: Raise your Agent Rank to the maximum level.
achievements.summary: Reach the top Agent Rank.

guide.context: Agent Skills cannot be refunded. Save before spending points so you can reload to change your mind. The last 300 points only come after the final boss.

steps.text: Spend Anomaly Points on Agent Skills as you earn them from main and side missions.
Beat the final boss to earn 150 more points, then load the cleared save.
After loading the cleared save, finish the post-game side mission for the last 150 points, then spend everything until Agent Rank stops rising.

achievements.description: Win the title in The Greatest OMNI Carnival.
achievements.sortReason: Final matches open at the end of the story.
achievements.summary: Win the title in The Greatest OMNI Carnival.

guide.context: @npc{Volcanomon} sends a Digiline message when the second-to-last fight is ready.

steps.text: Start it by talking to @npc{Volcanomon} in @loc{Paradise Colosseum} during @loc{The Violence of Humans}.
Win every match. New matches open as you finish side missions and story.

Before the final boss dialogue, head to the far left edge, beyond your allies standing on the cliff, and go into the @loc{In-Between Theater} to open the second-to-last match. Win it to open the final match against @enemy{Marsmon}.

achievements.description: Spend 1,000,000 YEN in shops.
achievements.sortReason: Spend yen in shops over the game.
achievements.summary: Pay a total of 1,000,000 YEN at shops.

guide.context: Spending adds up across all purchases. One farm that worked: after loading a cleared save, fight @enemy{Olympos XII} in @loc{Akihabara: A Certain Back Alley} for about 300,000 yen per run.

steps.text: Buy items from shops until your total spending reaches 1,000,000 yen.

achievements.sortReason: Collection side mission opened at the end of the story.
achievements.summary: Collect all 13 of Hiroko Sagisaka's Monikers.

guide.context: This side mission opens during the final main mission after you finish A Gift from the Hosts. Leave the In-Between Theater and Time Jump to each place. Any order works. When you have all 13, return to the In-Between Theater for the last message.

achievements.description: Bring every Royal Knight to Central Tower.
achievements.sortReason: Many side-mission chains at end of story.
achievements.summary: Bring every Royal Knight to Central Tower.

guide.context: Eleven knights gather on top of Central Tower when you finish: Craniamon, Gallantmon, Magnamon, Examon, Dynasmon, Leopardmon, Gankoomon, Jesmon, Kentaurosmon, LordKnightmon and UlforceVeedramon.

steps.text: Once A Missing Friend, Between the Worlds and A Gift from the Hosts are all finished, talk to @npc{King Drasil} in the @loc{In-Between Theater} VIP room.
Go to the top of @loc{Central Tower} with @npc{Agumon} and @npc{Gabumon} to open six side-mission chains.
Complete all six chains: @loc{A Stubborn Fighter?}, @loc{A Facilitator's Woes}, @loc{Duels Must Be Fair}, @loc{Veemon's Growth}, @loc{One Shield Maker's Struggle} and @loc{Knowing One's Strength}.
Return to @npc{King Drasil} in the VIP room to finish.

achievements.description: Discover all of the Outer Dungeons.
achievements.sortReason: Dungeons are discovered across the story and post-game.
achievements.summary: Discover all of the Outer Dungeons.

guide.context: Outer Dungeons are red portals in the world. Some open only after story progress. If the achievement is missing after you find them all, go back to the first Time Attack Boss Battle portal in Akihabara.

collectibles.name: Survive to the End 1
collectibles.method: Reach it through East Shopping District.

collectibles.method: Go down to the train platform at Shinjuku Station.

collectibles.method: Available after you return to the present.

collectibles.method: Late-game area.

achievements.description: Beat the main challenge of every Outer Dungeon.
achievements.sortReason: Beat main challenge in each dungeon after finding them.
achievements.summary: Beat the main challenge of every Outer Dungeon.

guide.context: Survive to the End: stay alive until the timer ends. Speed is Victory: win the race. Time Attack Boss Battle: defeat the boss that closes each challenge. Fight the Ultimate Digimon: beat the three strongest enemies. Protect the Giant Digimeat: stop all 30 enemies from crossing the defense line.

steps.text: Find every Outer Dungeon, then beat the main challenge in each one.
Skip the extra optional challenges. They are not required.

achievements.description: Obtain all of the achievements.
achievements.summary: Obtain all of the achievements.

steps.text: Unlock every other achievement. This one unlocks on its own.
